claims: The 130th Boston Marathon is scheduled for Monday, April 20, 2026.
The 130th Boston Marathon is a 26.2-mile race from Hopkinton to Copley Square.
Over 30,000 runners are expected to participate in the 130th Boston Marathon.
Qualification applications for the 130th Boston Marathon or future races are managed through the Boston Athletic Association.
Registration for the 2026 Boston Marathon occurred September 8–12, 2025.
The 2026 Boston Marathon featured a 4:34 cutoff.
Applicants needed to run 4:34 faster than their qualifying standard to gain entry to the 2026 Boston Marathon.
24,362 qualifiers were accepted out of 33,249 applicants for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Early predictions suggest temperatures between 55-60°F for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
The course for the 2026 Boston Marathon is the traditional point-to-point course from Hopkinton to Boston (Copley Square).
Elite wheelchair starts for the 2026 Boston Marathon are around 9:00 a.m.
Professional starts follow elite wheelchair starts for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Wave starts begin at 10:00 a.m. for the 2026 Boston Marathon.
The 2026 qualifying standards remain consistent with previous years.
